name: friction-review
description: Use this skill to turn recurring friction-log patterns into specific, minimal, human-reviewed amendments to rules/ or skills/. Runs scripts/analyse-friction.sh, proposes a diff per pattern, never auto-applies.
when: When reviewing recurring friction-log entries to propose rule/skill amendments
do-not-use-when: Logging a single friction entry — use .agent/scripts/log-friction.sh directly
The friction log is empty or has no recurring patterns
Reviewing a code diff or PR — use code-review instead
